entries.c49901506edfbcd8: This business leases real estate owned by the company to tenants. It leases a rental warehouse on the site of the Atsugi Plant at the head office, rental residences in Tokyo and similar properties. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is ¥757 million.
entries.c572e24a2a9e53b4: It is a specialist manufacturer of fuel supply systems, launched in 1932 as Japan's only carburetor specialist factory, and handles everything from carburetors to electronically controlled fuel injection systems and ECUs. It has production and sales subsidiaries in China, the United States, India and Thailand, giving it a structure to handle sales for overseas markets.
entries.d03c0f0f16dbc48b: Its 3-year medium-term management plan, launched in fiscal 2024, sets as its basic policy to steadily advance the transformation and review of its business structure, reliably achieve the shift to a growth trajectory, and aim for sustained growth and development and a further increase in corporate value. As its medium- to long-term management strategy, it states that it will steadily implement measures to improve profitability, concentrate and select management resources on growth businesses, and build a stable earnings foundation.
entries.d5322b9ab214d020: In the [Management Policy, Business Environment and Issues to Be Addressed] section, it is printed that as an automotive parts manufacturer, the company needs to respond appropriately to major changes in the external environment toward decarbonization, and that it will advance the transformation and review of its business structure.
entries.e918b0dfc3be748d: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥9,269 million. Due to firm sales of general-purpose products for the U.S. market, among other factors, revenue increased 10.9% from the previous consolidated fiscal year. By business segment, the General-Purpose Equipment Business was ¥3,918 million and the Gas Appliance Business was ¥3,124 million.
entries.f3953bb89ee514f5: This business manufactures and sells pneumatic control equipment parts, construction machinery parts and similar products. The company, Kanagawa Seiko Co., Ltd. and Oshima Kiko Co., Ltd. manufacture and sell the products. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is ¥669 million.
